source: 刘晓燕《四级你还在背单词吗》
title: The Rules of the Workshop
tts_text: A short troop of workers gathered at the gate. What would precede the morning shift were a few simple rules. The whole process was written down on a board, and the procedure had not changed in twenty years. Access to the tools was free, but only to those who signed the book. Anyone who tried to exceed the daily limit would find a small fine instead. Beyond that first warning, there was an excess charge on the pay slip. Old habits had to recede, and the manager was not willing to concede. So they reached a compromise between speed and care. Success, he said, would not come from one big push. Succeeding meant repeating small acts until they stuck. In quick succession, the workers learned each task. Each young successor to an older hand was paired with a teacher, and those who excel at their craft taught the rest. Then came the hardest part. The floor was not static. A machine does not move on its own. Motion needs a motive, and a wage alone rarely succeeds in motivating anyone for long. So he began to remove the dull parts, and used emotion as a tool rather than a problem. It was rational to do so, and the ratio of finished work to wasted time rose sharply. He kept a remote corner of the workshop as a place to think. Promote one of them, and the others would follow. Action, he said, always beats talk. Behave as if the work matters, and stay active. Then activate the same rule in your own head.

In quick succession, the workers learned each task.
Each young successor to an older hand was paired with a teacher, and those who excel at their craft taught the rest.
Then came the hardest part.
The floor was not static.
A machine does not move on its own.
Motion needs a motive, and a wage alone rarely succeeds in motivating anyone for long.
So he began to remove the dull parts, and used emotion as a tool rather than a problem.
It was rational to do so, and the ratio of finished work to wasted time rose sharply.
He kept a remote corner of the workshop as a place to think.
Promote one of them, and the others would follow.
Action, he said, always beats talk.
Behave as if the work matters, and stay active.
Then activate the same rule in your own head.
sentences_cn: 一小队工人聚集在门口。
早班之前，是几条简单的规矩。
整个过程写在一块板上，这套流程二十年没变过。
工具是随便用的，但只有签名登记的人才能用。
谁想超出每日限额，换来的是一笔小额罚款。
越过第一次警告之后，工资单上会多一笔超额费用。
旧习惯必须退去，而经理不愿意让步。
于是他们在速度与谨慎之间达成了折中。
他说，成功不会来自一次猛冲。
所谓成功，就是重复小的动作，直到它们固定下来。
工人们一个接一个地迅速学会了每项任务。
每个接替老师傅的年轻继任者都配了一位师傅，而那些手艺出众的人则去教其余的人。
接下来是最难的部分。
地面不是静止的。
机器不会自己动。
运动需要动机，而单靠工资很少能长久地激励任何人。
于是他开始去掉那些枯燥的环节，把情绪当作工具而不是问题。
这样做是理性的，成品与浪费时间的比率大幅上升。
他把车间一个偏僻的角落留作思考的地方。
提拔他们中的一个，其余的人就会跟上。
他说，行动永远胜过空谈。
表现得像这份工作很重要，并保持主动。
然后，把同一条规则在你自己的脑子里激活。
